interface.signature: def longestKSubstr(S: str, K: int) -> int:

preconditions.description: The length of string S is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The integer K is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in S are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The returned value is either -1 (no valid substring) or a positive integer representing the length of the longest valid substring.

postconditions.expression: any(len(set(S[i:j])) == K for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i + 1, len(S) + 1)) or return_value == -1
postconditions.description: If there exists at least one substring in S with exactly K distinct characters, return_value is the length of the longest such substring; otherwise, return_value is -1.
